column1: # Black/Matrix AD - English script: Chapter 1 seasonal care event / Prague
# offset<TAB>english      The pixel-aware wrapper supplies layout.

column2: Hmph! What are you trying to say...?
I have something for you.
What is it? Who told you you could ask such things one by one!?
Just shut up and take it...!!
Huff... huff... huff... You're in my way! Go over there!
(What if you catch it too...)
Hmph! Don't you understand? I told you I'm all right, didn't I...!
Later, I'll make your body remember every bit of the $$お仕置き$$ for disobeying me. Prepare yourself...
Huff... huff... I-I can hardly breathe...
Where does it hurt? Even if I told you, you couldn't fix it!
Huff... huff... Hmph! I feel sick. You can see that for yourself, can't you!?
In spring, all kinds of plants bear fruit, and fish begin dancing in the rivers...
It's a wonderful season for the palate~!
Even you, so dull as you are, know what I'm getting at, don't you...?
...What do I want to eat, you ask...??
Hmph! Go find some seasonal $$食材$$...
and use that head of yours to think!
$$野菜$$, $$野菜$$—like that's the only thing you know...
Make something that gives you strength every once in a while, too!
Listen! Bringing in the foods that are in season...
is the very best thing you can do for your body! Understood? Put it into practice!
...What do I want to eat, you ask?
Hmph! Well... Do you know truffles...?
They're a type of mushroom that grows beneath black pine groves...
And they're incredibly hard to find...
If you manage to find some, then I'll have to give you some sort of $$ご褒美$$...!
Autumn really is when fish are delicious...!
Naturally, you're going to catch fish for me, aren't you?!
It's about time mitten crabs began swimming upstream to spawn...
Crabs are full of eggs at this time, so soak them in sake to make drunken crab—it's delicious...!
All right! Now get to it!!
It's cold today...
$$鍋物$$, you say?
Oh! For once, you've said something sensible...!
Oh, new potatoes...?
Hmm, they look tasty! I trust you with the cooking, then!
Oh, edamame...? They must be in season right about now.
I'd love to boil them in saltwater and have a drink!!
Oh, taro, isn't it!?
Simmered and glazed would be good, but...
This time of year makes me want to hold a taro stew gathering by the riverbank!
Oh, th-this is...
The legendary red leek!!
This leek sometimes comes about only when it's grown with great care in loose soil and given sunlight...
It gets sweeter when cooked, so it's perfect for $$鍋物$$...!
Oh, w-what's wrong...?
If you're feeling unwell... tell me properly! Understand...?!
Hmph! Why are you being so needy...?
If you don't stop lazing about and do your $$リハビリ$$, I'll make sure you can't stand on your feet for an entirely different reason!!
You... Y-You're all right, aren't you...?
Honestly, enough for today. Take the day off and rest...!
That's an order!!
You... Y-You're all right, aren't you...?
Honestly, enough for today. Take the day off and rest...!
That's an order!!
Honestly...! This is why I can't just leave you alone!
(Please don't overdo it.)
Are you... really all right?
If you get sick, do you understand who'll have to take care of you...?
Don't overdo it!
Hmph! Looks like you've been working hard. Thanks to that, the whole room reeks of sweat!
Now get in the bath... and clean that sweaty body of yours!
You seem to be working hard, but...
there are still plenty of other jobs you have to do...
mountains of them! Don't let your guard down...!
